officialInventory.summary: The Forestry Development Authority (FDA) is the statutory PA authority (National Forestry Reform Law 2006; Protected Forest Areas Network Act 2003). Its June 2026 Kwa gazettement package states the network comprises five legally established PAs and lists the proposed PAs; the NBSAP 2017-2025 (Table 10, source FDA) gives areas. No machine-readable list found.

statedCounts.quote: Liberia’s Protected Area Network comprises five legally established protected areas
with 5 areas protected so far, and 11 others proposed
There are eleven (11) national forests currently under partial protection

areas.name: Sapo National Park

legalStatus.text: Created 1983; extended by the Act for the Extension of the Sapo National Park (approved 10 Oct 2003), managed as a permanent component of the Protected Forest Area Network.

areas.notes: Sinoe, River Gee and Grand Gedeh counties. Area: 180,400 ha after the 2003 extension (FDA 2026); NBSAP table gives 184,406 ha; the 2003 Act's title says 445,677 acres (body text 445,667 acres).

areas.name: East Nimba Nature Reserve

legalStatus.text: Act for the Establishment of the East Nimba Nature Reserve (2003).

areas.notes: Nimba County. Area 13,569 ha per NBSAP Table 10 (FDA). The FDA 2026 package also titles the Act '(2011)' while stating the reserve was gazetted in 2003. The FDA links its creation to the international importance of the Mount Nimba UNESCO World Heritage site.

areas.name: Lake Piso Multiple Sustainable Use Reserve

legalStatus.text: Legally established protected area (2011) per FDA.

areas.notes: North-western Liberia; NBSAP photo caption shows the Atlantic beach at Lake Piso. Also a Ramsar site (5NR). Area figures conflict: 97,975 ha in NBSAP Table 10 vs 48,593 ha in the 5th National Report (which gives 97,975 ha for Gola) — left null.

areas.name: Gola Forest National Park

legalStatus.text: An Act Establishing the Gola Forest National Park, enacted (handbill) 27 January 2017.

areas.notes: Mostly Gbarpolu County; transboundary with Gola Rainforest NP (Sierra Leone). Year: 2016 per FDA network list and 6NR ('September, 2016'), Act handbill dated 27 Jan 2017. Area 88,000 ha (6NR); NBSAP gives 88,130 ha.

areas.name: Grebo-Krahn National Park

legalStatus.text: An Act Establishing the Grebo-Krahn National Park, enacted (handbill) 9 October 2017.

areas.notes: Grand Gedeh and River Gee counties; 97,136 ha (6NR). Part of the Taï-Grebo-Krahn-Sapo transboundary forest landscape.

areas.name: Wonegizi Proposed Protected Area
areas.notes: Lofa County. FDA notice of intent (7 July 2026; comment period 9 July-6 Sept 2026) to designate it a Multiple Sustainable Use Reserve under s.9.1a of the National Forestry Reform Law 2006; 27,979 ha pending final validated boundary. Earlier listed as 'Wonegizi Nature Reserve' (NBSAP, 37,979 ha).

areas.name: Kwa National Park (proposed)
areas.notes: Grand Gedeh, Sinoe and Rivercess counties; 172,200 ha per FDA draft gazettement package (June 2026).

areas.name: Wologizi Proposed Protected Area
areas.notes: Listed by FDA (2026) among proposed protected areas.

areas.name: Foya Proposed Protected Area
areas.notes: Lofa County. 164,628 ha per NBSAP Table 10 (FDA source, 2017).

areas.name: Kpo Mountains Proposed Protected Area
areas.notes: 'Kpo Mountains (near Zelekai)', 83,709 ha per NBSAP Table 10.

areas.name: Cestos-Senkwehn Proposed Protected Area
areas.notes: Coastal centre of Liberia (6NR). 80,348 ha per NBSAP Table 10.

areas.name: Grand Kru-River Gee Proposed Protected Area
Marshall Wetlands Proposed Protected Area
areas.notes: Listed as 'Margibi Mangroves “Marshall Islands”', 23,813 ha in NBSAP Table 10.

areas.name: Gbi Proposed Protected Area
areas.notes: 88,409 ha per NBSAP Table 10 (2017); not named in the FDA 2026 list of proposed areas.

areas.name: Bong Mountains (Yoma) Proposed Protected Area
areas.notes: 24,813 ha per NBSAP Table 10 (2017); not named in the FDA 2026 list.

areas.name: West Nimba Proposed Protected Area
areas.notes: 10,482 ha per NBSAP Table 10 (2017); not named in the FDA 2026 list.

notEnumerated.reason: Production forests from which concessions are carved; not protected areas in the strict sense.

gaps: Liberia has no designated marine protected area in sources seen; the 6NR sets a target to 'Establish at least 2 marine protected areas'.
Lake Piso's legal instrument (2011) and area were not verified; NBSAP and 5NR area figures conflict.
The FDA (2026) lists 8 proposed PAs whereas NBSAP 2017 lists 10 and the 6NR says 11; Gbi, Bong Mountains and West Nimba were not in the FDA 2026 list, so their current proposal status is unclear.
Wonegizi gazettement was in public-comment stage (to 6 Sept 2026); outcome unknown.
The Protected Forest Areas Network Act (2003) text itself was not fetched (only referenced by the FDA and ClientEarth).
areaKm2 values were converted from hectares (1 km² = 100 ha) where the cited source gives hectares; source figures are quoted in notes where they conflict.
